title: Clinical trial to determine the efficacy and safety of AP707 in the treatment of Borderline Personality Disorder
official: A phase II, double-blinded, placebo-controlled, clinical trial to determine the efficacy and safety of AP707 in the treatment of Borderline Personality Disorder.
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of this trial is to show the efficacy of AP707 in Borderline Personality Disorder participants compared to placebo regarding the Zanarini Rating Scale for Borderline Personality Disorder (ZAN-BPD) and the Borderline Symptom Scale for Borderline Personality Disorder (BSL-23).
